observation.happening: Software update notification dialog asking user to download Astra 1.0. Shows version changelog with three main improvements: meeting recording pause/resume, audio recognition feedback, and transcript improvements.
observation.most_important: Clear update prompt with tangible feature benefits listed. Two action buttons with strong contrast (blue primary action vs gray secondary).
observation.next_action: User clicks 'インストール' to proceed with update or 'スキップ' to dismiss

observation.happening: Real-time meeting transcription interface with active recording (04:21). Shows dual-panel layout: left panel with meeting notes (decisions/todos), right panel with live transcript. Top bar contains recording controls (pause, message, refresh, menu buttons).
observation.most_important: Active recording indicator with elapsed time prominent at top. Live transcription feed on right with speaker names and timestamps. Left panel organizes meeting outcomes by category (決まったこと/やること).
